task.description: WF-03 Step 3 REWORK 2: Fix blocker B1 reported by TEST-DESIGNER step-4-r1: in src/validation/typecheck.zig, the `.cmp_expr` case never validates operand compatibility — so a comparison like `s > 0` on an incompatible operand type yields 0 findings (no error) instead of an OperandTypeError. The int_vld_02_01 negative case (`s > 0`) expects an OperandTypeError but currently returns 0 findings. Add operand-type compatibility checking to the `.cmp_expr` branch so incompatible operands produce the expected finding. Verify: zig build exit 0; zig build test-validation 38/38; zig build test-integration-vld-unit -> 14/14 (int_vld_02_01 now passes). Commit on the feature branch.

result.summary: WF-03 Step 3-r2 BACKEND-DEV rework for ISS-0709/GH#799 blocker B1: added operand-type compatibility checking to the .cmp_expr branch of src/validation/typecheck.zig (checkCmpCompat + cmpOpSymbol helpers). Comparisons now require both operands to be the same concrete type; an incompatible pair (e.g. `s > 0`, string > number) emits OperandTypeError (VLD-02 AC3) and returns .dyn so checkSite skips the redundant TypeMismatch (spec pins '1 OperandTypeError, NOT TypeMismatch'). A .dyn operand (unknown variable) deliberately produces NO OperandTypeError, preserving the single UnknownVariable finding for `amont > 0` (int_vld_03_01 stays at 3 findings). Added two focused unit tests in typecheck.zig. Verification: zig build exit 0; test-validation 40/40 (38 existing + 2 new, no regression); test-integration-vld-unit 14/14 (int_vld_02_01 negative case `s > 0` now yields OperandTypeError). No error-set gaps. Full `zig build test` has a pre-existing unrelated failure (definition-store test roots missing `graph` module import) confirmed on the base commit — out of scope. Committed as 844c2016 (not pushed per constraint).
